webhookSecret.title: Webhook secrets
webhookSecret.description: Each repository signs its pull-request webhook deliveries with a secret. Deliveries for a repository without one are refused.
webhookSecret.rotateDescription: A new secret replaces the current one. Deliveries signed with the old secret are refused until the webhook at your Git provider is updated.
webhookSecret.removeDescription: Every webhook delivery for this repository is refused until a new secret is generated. The current secret cannot be recovered.
webhookSecret.revealDescription: Paste this value into the secret field of the webhook at your Git provider.
webhookSecret.revealWarningTitle: This is the only time it is shown
webhookSecret.revealWarningBody: McHarbor stores the secret encrypted and cannot show it again. If you lose it, rotate the secret to get a new one.
